# ZeeKay Editz

> ZeeKay Editz is a premium video editing and motion design studio serving YouTube creators and brands in the US, UK, and EU. Founded by Zahid Ali (Zeekay). The studio edits cartoon commentary, sports documentaries, gaming videos and YouTube explainers, and specializes in style-matched editing — replicating and executing recognizable YouTube editing styles (Glass-style cartoon commentary, Pexto, SunnyV2-style documentaries, Ryan Pictures, iceberg explainers, true crime, VSL/direct-response) with After Effects motion graphics and retention-focused Premiere Pro editing.

Pricing: Signature After Effects edits are $400 per 15-minute video (custom animations, kinetic typography, cinematic sound design). Growth long-form edits in Premiere Pro from $60 per video up to 10 minutes (volume rate for cashcow and high-upload channels). Every new client receives a free 1-minute sample edit of their own footage before paying anything. Remote-first, worldwide, US/UK/EU friendly hours. Contact: https://zeekayeditz.com/#contact

## Video Editing Services

- [Video Editing Portfolio](https://zeekayeditz.com/video-editing-portfolio.html): See how different editing choices support different stories. This featured video editing portfolio brings together the nine Best Work examples from our homepage so you can compare the direction before sending your brief.

- [Event Promo Video Editing](https://zeekayeditz.com/event-promo-video-editing.html): Bring the event, its atmosphere and the practical details into one clear promo. We edit event announcements and teasers from your supplied footage, photographs, brand assets and approved information.

- [Fiverr Gig Video Editing](https://zeekayeditz.com/gig-video-editing.html): Make your service easy to understand in a short seller video. We edit Fiverr gig videos and freelance service promos with a clear opening, relevant work samples, readable offer details and an agreed call to action.

- [Isaac Style Video Editing](https://zeekayeditz.com/isaac-style-video-editing.html): Start with a specific reference and build a treatment for your own story. Our Isaac-style video editing service uses the Isaac 01 portfolio sample to discuss narration pacing, visual emphasis and the graphic direction for a YouTube edit.

- [Hand Drawn Video Editing](https://zeekayeditz.com/hand-drawn-video-editing.html): Use a drawn visual language to support your narration. Our hand drawn video editing service combines agreed illustrations, text, cutouts and motion into sketch-style explainers, educational stories and commentary.

- [Health & Wellness Video Editing](https://zeekayeditz.com/health-video-editing.html): Give your approved health or wellness script a clear visual explanation. We edit narrated health videos with relevant footage, readable terminology, captions and supporting graphics, keeping the presentation aligned with your message.

- [Bodycam Video Editing](https://zeekayeditz.com/bodycam-video-editing.html): Turn long recordings into a sequence your audience can follow. Our bodycam video editing service combines selected footage, commentary, readable captions and clear context for YouTube crime and police-footage channels.

- [Crime Intro Video Editing](https://zeekayeditz.com/crime-intro-video-editing.html): Open the case with a reason to keep watching. Our crime intro video editing service builds a focused cold open from your narration, source clips and approved case facts, then hands the viewer into the full story.

- [All Video Editing Services](https://zeekayeditz.com/video-editing-services.html): Choose by niche and style, compare portfolio samples, review project scope and request a quote.
- [Cartoon Commentary Video Editing](https://zeekayeditz.com/cartoon-video-editing.html): Hire a cartoon video editor for YouTube commentary, episode rankings and character analysis. Watch our cartoon sample and request a free 1-minute test edit.
- [Sports Video Editing](https://zeekayeditz.com/sports-video-editing.html): Hire a sports video editor for NBA stories, football documentaries and highlight videos. Watch six real edits, review pricing and get a free 1-minute sample.
- [Gaming Video Editing](https://zeekayeditz.com/gaming-video-editing.html): Hire a gaming video editor for YouTube gameplay, funny moments, guides and highlights. Watch our Arc Raiders and GTA samples. Free 1-minute test edit.
- [YouTube Explainer Video Editing](https://zeekayeditz.com/explainer-video-editing.html): Hire a YouTube explainer video editor for narrated videos, video essays and faceless channels. See real samples, motion graphics and a free 1-minute test edit.

Portfolio examples include The Best Episodes In Cartoon History (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=D-Qvc6EKg6E), NBA and Erling Haaland sports edits, Arc Raiders gameplay, GTA explainers and hand-drawn-style motion graphics. See the service pages for context and original video links.

The cartoon service is commentary and analysis editing; original character animation requires a separate scope. Video editing does not guarantee copyright clearance, platform monetization or audience growth. Client footage, asset sourcing, finished runtime and delivery formats are agreed before quoting.

Contact the studio through https://zeekayeditz.com/#contact or its public Fiverr profile at https://www.fiverr.com/zeekayeditz1.

## Editing Style Pages

- [SunnyV2 Style Video Editing](https://zeekayeditz.com/sunnyv2-style-video-editing.html): Turn a researched script into a clear YouTube documentary. Our SunnyV2-style video editing service is for narration-led creator stories, rise-and-fall timelines and commentary that needs source material, context and a strong narrative sequence.

- [Glass Style Cartoon Video Editing](https://zeekayeditz.com/glass-style-video-editing.html): A cartoon commentary edit should follow the argument and land the joke. Our Glass-style video editing service focuses on animated-series commentary, episode rankings and character analysis, using scene selection, reactions and graphics shaped around your voiceover.

- [Pexto Style Video Editing](https://zeekayeditz.com/pexto-style-video-editing.html): How the studio replicates Pexto's fast-paced style — beat-locked cuts, zoom hierarchy, meme timing, SFX layering — with client samples.
- [Ryan Pictures Style Video Editing](https://zeekayeditz.com/ryan-pictures-style-video-editing.html): Documentary-grade Ryan Pictures style editing with cinematic pacing and motion design, with samples.
- [Iceberg Style Video Editing](https://zeekayeditz.com/iceberg-style-video-editing.html): Iceberg explainer format editing — tiered reveals, atmospheric sound design, long-form retention structure.
- [True Crime Video Editing](https://zeekayeditz.com/true-crime-video-editing.html): True crime channel editing — tension pacing, evidence graphics, atmospheric grading.
- [VSL Video Editing](https://zeekayeditz.com/vsl-video-editing.html): Hire a VSL video editor for video sales letter editing, approved proof graphics, captions and clear calls to action. Includes two portfolio samples and a briefing guide.

## Plugins

- [ZFlow - Bezier Easing for Adobe Premiere Pro](https://zeekayeditz.com/zflow/): $19.99 one-time Premiere Pro panel that writes a real cubic-bezier easing curve into the span between any two existing keyframes. 28 named curves (Basic, Sine, Quad, Cubic, Quart, Quint, Expo, Circ, Back), an After Effects style speed graph with a magnetic zero line, overshoot curves Premiere ease handles cannot reach, batch stagger across a selection, and copy-as CSS / expression / raw values. Works on Position, Scale, Rotation, Opacity, Anchor Point and any keyframeable effect parameter. Requires Premiere Pro 25.6 or higher, macOS and Windows. Runs fully offline and collects no data.
- [Buy ZFlow on the Adobe Creative Cloud Marketplace](https://exchange.adobe.com/apps/cc/77edc3d5/zflow): Official Adobe Exchange listing, version 3.2.2, published 14 August 2026. Install directly from Creative Cloud.
- [ZFlow Support and FAQ](https://zeekayeditz.com/zflow/support): Install steps for Creative Cloud and manual installs, troubleshooting, keyboard shortcuts, and contact at admin@zeekayeditz.com.

## Blog

- [Want After Effects-Quality Animation in Premiere? The Problem Is Not Premiere](https://zeekayeditz.com/blog/after-effects-quality-animation-in-premiere.html): Premiere already offers Linear, Bezier, Auto Bezier, Continuous Bezier, Hold, Ease In and Ease Out plus draggable handles, so the gap versus After Effects is repeatability, not capability. Four cubic-bezier recipes with exact control points (Quint Out 0.22,1,0.36,1; Expo In-Out 0.87,0,0.13,1; Back Out 0.34,1.56,0.64,1; Circ Out 0,0.55,0.45,1), five timing rules, a no-plugin manual method, and the ZFlow panel that makes it repeatable.
- [Why Your Best Video Flopped (And a Worse One Went Viral)](https://zeekayeditz.com/blog/why-your-best-video-flopped.html): YouTube performance as a chain of three gates — impressions, click-through, retention — why effort and results come apart, and how to diagnose which gate failed.
- [Why Viewers Stop Watching in the First 30 Seconds](https://zeekayeditz.com/blog/why-viewers-stop-watching-first-30-seconds.html): The three psychological exits behind early drop-off — cognitive overload, broken promises, closed loops — and the editing fix for each.
- [The Hidden Cost of Editing Your Own YouTube Videos](https://zeekayeditz.com/blog/hidden-cost-of-editing-your-own-videos.html): The real math on DIY editing — hours, upload cadence, skill ceiling, burnout — and when outsourcing becomes arbitrage.
- [How Much Does a Video Editor Cost in 2026?](https://zeekayeditz.com/blog/how-much-does-a-video-editor-cost.html): Real market rates — $25–$75 basic, $60–$150 professional, $200–$500+ signature After Effects — and how to choose a pricing model.
- [How to Edit Like Pexto](https://zeekayeditz.com/blog/how-to-edit-like-pexto.html): The 5 mechanics behind Pexto's editing style, broken down by a studio that edits it for clients.
- [VSL Editing Guide](https://zeekayeditz.com/blog/vsl-editing-guide.html): The 5 VSL editing rules that move conversion rates, plus what VSL editing costs.
- [After Effects Hooks for Bodycam Videos](https://zeekayeditz.com/blog/after-effects-hooks-bodycam-videos.html): Hook techniques for bodycam and police-footage channels.
- [Video Editing Mistakes Killing YouTube Retention](https://zeekayeditz.com/blog/video-editing-mistakes-killing-youtube-retention.html): Common editing mistakes that hurt watch time and how to fix them.
- [All posts](https://zeekayeditz.com/blog.html)
